response: Saved Views is available today, giving every user a faster way to work with the boards, lists, and filters they rely on most. Instead of rebuilding the same filter combinations each time you open a project, you can now capture any configuration — filters, sorting, grouping, and column layout — as a named view and return to it in a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so there's nothing extra to purchase or activate. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, client, sprint, or personal workflow without running out of space. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or keeping tabs on a client's requests, Saved Views keeps that context ready whenever you need it. Give it a try on your next project. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
